basic_info.description: Modern City Living with Comfort and Style. Welcome to your next urban retreat a stylish and well-appointed 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom residence in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Mission Bay. Thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertaining, this home features a bright and spacious living area ideal for unwinding or hosting friends.    The open-concept dining space flows seamlessly into a sleek kitchen outfitted with granite counters, rich wood cabinetry, a convenient pantry, and a full suite of stainless steel appliances perfect for culinary adventures at home.    The generously sized bedroom offers a peaceful escape, complete with a walk-in closet and in-unit washer and dryer for added ease. Beyond the front door, enjoy resort-style amenities including a fitness center, heated pool, and secure gated entry. Residents also have access to a dog-friendly environment with a private dog park, a resident lounge for gatherings, and a business center ideal for remote work. Situated just moments from Oracle Park and surrounded by top-tier dining, shopping, green spaces, and excellent transit options, this is city living at its finest.
